sentences.en: The shoes are on sale this week, so you can save some money.
sentences.zh: 这周鞋子打折，你可以省点钱。

sentences.en: Don't buy that coffee machine; it's on sale next month at a lower price.
sentences.zh: 别买那个咖啡机；下个月打折还便宜。

sentences.en: I found some nice curtains on sale in the window of the store.
sentences.zh: 我在商店橱窗里看到一些打折的窗帘。
